//bundled: A snapshot of catalogue.json in FAForeverRustClient/guides, taken 2026-10-05.
Shipped so that a client which has never reached the repository (first start
offline, a blocked network) still opens to a library rather than an empty tab.
The client prefers the live document, then the last copy it fetched, then this.
Refresh it from the repository before a release; do not edit entries here.
//: The FAF training catalogue. Read by the FAF client's Training tab.
//editing: Accepting a submission from the client writes this file, so keep it valid JSON.
Every field of a resource is optional except id and title.
An id is a file name and the key `related` points at: lowercase, hyphens.
//links: replayReviewChannel is where a replay review request is pasted, as a
one straight to the channel and the client copies the request on the way out,
so the player lands in the right place with one paste left. Turn on Developer
Mode in Discord and use Copy Link on the channel. Empty falls back to discordUrl.
//resources: Guides, videos, build orders and channels somebody vouched for.
Destinations belong in `links` rather than here.
A guide written as text lives in guides/ and is linked by its raw address:
the client fetches that itself and renders it in the tab. The button that
opens a browser instead rewrites it to the github.com/blob address.
A page held here keeps its author's name and a link to the original on its
first line. Everything else is a link to where it lives.
`custom` as a game mode means a game outside the matchmaker. It resolves
to the global leaderboard, which is the rating such material is written
for. Pair it with a team size so the entry still matches a player whose
//trainers: The training team, shown as tiles in the client.
Only `name` is required. `accepting` defaults to true.
`fafId` is worth chasing: with it the tile opens the FAF player card,
resolves the real rating and avatar, and can be messaged from the client.
